title: GeoConfirmed geolocated event
description: Published BY bridges/vendors/geoconfirmed/geoconfirmed_bridge.py every GC_POLL_S for each placemark of the Ukraine conflict of the last GC_DAYS days. Data: GeoConfirmed (geoconfirmed.org), volunteer geolocation of conflict footage; every record credits it. The position is the geolocated place. A placemark that leaves the window is retracted with a one-shot {uid, type, _delete: true} tombstone.

uid.description: GC-<first 12 hex characters of the placemark id>.

faction.description: The placemark's faction, e.g. 'Russia (UKR)'. The topic's side is who struck, read from the kind of event: striker kinds (shelling, drones and missiles in use, killed civilians) take the faction's side, victim kinds (destroyed or damaged equipment, casualties) the opposite side, other kinds the faction's own side (neutral for civilians). Ukraine and NATO are friendly, Russia, Belarus and North Korea hostile.

role.description: striker: the faction struck; victim: the faction was struck, so the side is inferred as the other one; other: not a strike.

remarks.description: The full kind of event, the faction, the placemark id and the credit line.
